source_basis: Music does not evolve isolately, but is always influenced
interpretation: Opens by denying a simple picture, then names the real influences. Isolately is the L2 slip.
counterevidence: The denial is broad.

source_basis: the study of influence is the breakthrough point for our study
interpretation: Names the single hinge the whole paper turns on.
counterevidence: Breakthrough is a cliche; the placement saves it.

source_basis: can be measured in three ways. First... Second... Third...
interpretation: One term split into numbered mechanisms before any model.
counterevidence: The three ways overlap.

source_basis: because it is not mentioned in the data set
interpretation: An assumption justified by an absence in the file, not by a claim about the world.
counterevidence: Absence of evidence is not evidence of equality.

source_basis: Inspired by PageRank, we calculate the influence of nodes
interpretation: A borrowed method credited in the sentence that adopts it.
counterevidence: Inspiration is not a derivation.

source_basis: It should be noted that in the original algorithm the edge points the other way
interpretation: A deliberate break with the source method, flagged before the reader can object.
applicability: Reusable whenever a convention is reversed.
counterevidence: The reversal is exactly where the formulas go wrong.

source_basis: The larger the area of the node, the more outgoing links
interpretation: A visual encoding stated as a proportion, in the caption's voice.
counterevidence: Area encodes degree, which the text elsewhere calls influence.

source_basis: Assuming a network with only three nodes A, B, C
interpretation: The general rule taught on a toy graph first.
counterevidence: The toy contradicts the later formula.

source_basis: consistent with the reality and achieves our expected effect
interpretation: Validation by recognition: the top names are famous, so the score works.
counterevidence: Fame is not a test.

source_basis: The Beatles is no doudt the most influencial band
interpretation: A verdict left with two spelling errors. Unedited conviction.
applicability: Keep the conviction, fix the spelling only if asked.
counterevidence: The typos hurt credibility.

source_basis: We think this is reasonable
interpretation: A result defended by imagining the behavior that would produce it.
counterevidence: The story is plausible, not evidenced.

source_basis: so our influence model is successful
interpretation: The author grades their own model in the text, repeatedly.
counterevidence: Agreement with a remembered fact is a weak test.

source_basis: PageRank reversed so value flows from follower to influencer
interpretation: A standard algorithm modified, with the modification stated.
counterevidence: The formulas do not all implement it.

source_basis: Both Euclidean and cosine similarity computed and compared
interpretation: Two measures kept as a cross-check.
counterevidence: They largely agree, so one is redundant.

source_basis: Inherited if within 5 percent; contagious if the share exceeds 0.6
interpretation: Two thresholds turn a continuous gap into a yes.
counterevidence: Both are round numbers.

source_basis: The most popular track's curve leads the genre mean
interpretation: A lag read off a plot becomes a causal claim.
applicability: Call it a reading, not a test.
counterevidence: No significance test.

source_basis: Equations 1 to 3 sum PR directly; equation 4 divides by in-degree
interpretation: The worked example and the general formula describe different update rules.
applicability: Check a toy example against the general formula.
counterevidence: Could be a notation slip rather than a coding error.

source_basis: Pop/Rock narrated as infancy, development, maturity
interpretation: A life-cycle story laid over a curve.
applicability: Reusable, but label it as a story.
counterevidence: The stage boundaries are round decades.

source_basis: Subnetwork order matches the global order
interpretation: Stability defined as rank agreement on a subset.
counterevidence: The subset is part of the whole, so agreement is partly guaranteed.

source_basis: Damping plus or minus 0.15 gives under 5 percent error; dimension plus or minus 3 gives under 2 percent
interpretation: Two one-parameter sweeps, each with a declared pass line.
counterevidence: The pass lines are the authors' own.

source_basis: Each artist reduced to one mean vector
interpretation: A strong compression, stated openly.
counterevidence: Range and change over a career disappear.

source_basis: Key dropped after consulting music theory; tempo and loudness normalized
interpretation: Feature selection justified by domain reading.
counterevidence: The theory is not cited.

source_basis: Four assumptions, each short, two of them justified inline
interpretation: The justifications are about the file, not about the world.
counterevidence: Probabilistic inheritance is left vague.

source_basis: A major change is assumed to show within a year
interpretation: The time resolution of the whole revolution analysis.
counterevidence: A slow change would be invisible.

source_basis: 1964 to 1969 named, with five songs and a table
interpretation: A revolution pinned to specific recordings.
counterevidence: Popularity figures in the table are modest.

source_basis: Genre mean lags and is smoother than the hit
interpretation: Two qualitative comparisons, then an inference.
counterevidence: The lag is eyeballed.

source_basis: Depression, war, civil rights and personal computers placed on the curve
interpretation: Events selected to match bends.
counterevidence: Other events would fit other bends.

source_basis: Full network colored by genre, with a pie chart as the legend
interpretation: Color does the grouping; the legend is a separate figure.
counterevidence: Too many genres for one palette.

source_basis: Two heatmaps, Minkowski and cosine, sorted by genre
interpretation: The same ordering makes the two measures comparable at a glance.
applicability: Sort both axes the same way.
counterevidence: Color scales differ.

source_basis: Radar charts for one same-genre pair and one cross-genre pair
interpretation: The claim shown on two chosen examples.
counterevidence: Two pairs are anecdotes.

source_basis: The letter thanks the society and quotes John Lennon
interpretation: A required letter with a greeting, a body and a borrowed last line.
counterevidence: The quote is decorative.

source_basis: Strengths given as five single words: lightweight, creativity, accuracy, stability, scalability
interpretation: A list of virtues, each justified in one clause.
counterevidence: Accuracy is self-certified.
